root.label: Initialization Forms
root.note: Declaration syntax picks the C++ initialization algorithm before constructor overload resolution runs.

children.label: Default, Value & Zero
children.note: Controls whether scalar fields start uninitialized or deterministically zeroed.

children.label: Default-Initialization
children.note: Leaves stack scalars indeterminate and invokes default constructors on classes.

children.label: Value-Initialization
children.note: Zeroes scalars and defaulted classes without user-provided constructors before calling ctor.

children.label: Zero-Initialization
children.note: Clears static and thread-local storage before any dynamic initialization executes.

children.label: Direct vs. Copy
children.note: Separates explicit constructor eligibility and resolves the most vexing parse.

children.label: Direct-Initialization
children.note: Syntax T x(args) considers all constructors including explicit ones.

children.label: Copy-Initialization
children.note: Syntax T x = expr skips explicit constructors and conversion functions.

children.label: Most Vexing Parse
children.note: Widget w(); parses as a function declaration rather than a default-initialized variable.

children.label: List Initialization
children.note: Braced syntax prevents narrowing and function-parse ambiguity while adding two-phase lookup.

children.label: Narrowing Prohibition
children.note: Rejects lossy conversions unless converting a constant expression whose value fits.

children.label: Greedy initializer_list
children.note: Non-empty braces strongly prefer std::initializer_list constructors over normal overloads.

children.label: Empty Braces Rule
children.note: Empty T x{} selects the default constructor rather than an empty initializer_list.

children.label: Aggregate Initialization
children.note: Initializes public-member arrays and constructor-free structs directly in declaration order.

children.label: C++20 Aggregate Rule
children.note: Any user-declared constructor including = default or = delete disqualifies aggregate status.

children.label: Designated Initializers
children.note: Syntax {.field = val} initializes named aggregate members strictly in declaration order.

children.label: Parenthesized Aggregates
children.note: C++20 allows T(a, b) for aggregates so emplace and make_unique work seamlessly.
